def dots():
    d={}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]
        if 19<=r0<=41 and 18<=c0<=45 and n['color'] in 'O p R b N Y M'.split():
            d[(r0,c0)]=n['color']
    return [d.get((21,c)) for c in (21,27,39)], [d.get((35,c)) for c in (21,27,33,39)]
def click(r,c): action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
def space():
    r=action(['SPACE'])
    return bool(r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done'))
# D: red R,p,O / green M,Y,N,b  -> K: red N,Y,M / green O,p,R,b

click(22,28); click(36,28)   # swap red2 p <-> g2 Y

print('K:', dots())
if space(): print('COMPLETED at K')
else:
    # I: red O,p,R / green Y,N,b,M  (bar enters g3, path 3,2,1,4)
    # from K: red N,Y,M -> O,p,R ; green O,p,R,b -> Y,N,b,M
    click(22,22); click(36,21)  # red1 N <-> g1 O
    click(22,28); click(36,28)  # red2 Y <-> g2 p
    click(22,40); click(36,34)  # red4 M <-> g3 R
    print('I:', dots())
    if space(): print('COMPLETED at I')
    else:
        # J: red O,p,R / green Y,M,b,N
        click(36,28); click(36,34)  # g2 M <-> g3 N? wait J green: Y,M,b,N -> from I green Y,N,b,M: swap g2<->g3
        print('J:', dots())
        if space(): print('COMPLETED at J')
        else:
            # E: red M,Y,N / green b,R,p,O
            click(22,22); click(22,40)  # red1<->red4
            click(36,21); click(36,40)  # g1<->g4
            click(36,28); click(36,34)  # g2<->g3
            print('E:', dots())
            print('E space:', space())
